enMap.Hồi còn nhỏ, tôi rất thích đọc manga và: When I was young, I loved reading manga and often sketched manga pictures.
enMap.Bởi vì tôi cũng rất thích sáng tạo ra nh: Because I also love creating stories, in my first years of elementary school, I often had fun by drawing and imitating manga with storylines.
enMap.Lúc đầu, tôi chỉ vẽ bằng bút chì vào nhữ: At first, I only drew with pencil in notebooks, later I learned about pens and paper for writing manuscripts, I bought and used them.
enMap.Và như thế, tôi đã đăng tải tác phẩm hoà: And so, I uploaded the finished work to the comic selection section of the magazine in my high school years.
enMap.Sau khi đăng tải nhiều lần, vào lúc tôi: After posting many times, by the time I was in my first year of high school, I received an award worthy of my debut, and becoming a professional manga artist was decided.
enMap.Nếu cho rằng tôi đã có suy nghĩ: \"Cho d: If you think I had the thought: "No matter what, I want to become a manga artist" from the beginning, that's not the case.
enMap.Tôi đã từng có niềm mơ ước rằng thật tốt: I once had a dream that it would be nice to become a manga artist, but I didn't think I could for sure.
enMap.Hồi ấy tôi không thể đánh giá rõ ràng ch: At that time, I could not clearly assess where my abilities were headed and in what areas I could develop.
enMap.Tôi không suy nghĩ sâu sắc về tương lai: I don't think deeply about my future, and I'm also interested in many other fields besides being a manga artist.
enMap.Tôi cũng đã muốn trở thành nhà tiểu thuy: I also wanted to become a novelist or fairy tale writer, and also practiced dancing and singing with my friends with the hope of becoming an idol singer.
enMap.Tôi cũng đã muốn thử trở thành đạo diễn: I also wanted to try becoming a film director, photographer, designer... (following paragraph omitted)

idMap.Hồi ấy tôi không thể đánh giá rõ ràng ch: Saat itu, saya belum bisa menilai dengan jelas ke mana arah kemampuan saya dan bidang apa yang bisa saya kembangkan.

idMap.Tôi cũng đã muốn trở thành nhà tiểu thuy: Aku juga ingin menjadi novelis atau penulis dongeng, dan juga berlatih menari dan menyanyi bersama teman-temanku dengan harapan menjadi penyanyi idola.
